title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Urine Inflammation Panel (Multiplex, NULISAseq)
mission: SpaceX Inspiration4 (3-day Low Earth Orbit mission)
iss_medbay_module: Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) Cylinder & Fluid Balance
assays: NULISAseq 200plex v1 Inflammation Panel (203 immune/inflammatory protein targets)

protocols.sample_collection: Sterile urine collection cups, aliquoted and frozen at -80C.
protocols.units: NULISA Protein Quantification (NPQ) - log2 IPC-normalized counts

diagnostic_explanation: Microgravity-induced diuresis and central fluid redistribution reduce total plasma volume by 10-15% and concentrate renal inflammatory proteins.
